name: Smile Proud
summary: Smile Proud is a 2-player game aimed at providing psychosocial support to adolescents with cleft lip and/or palate. In the game, players work with their chosen Super Pet Pal, SuperCat or SuperPup, in going on missions to help others in difficult social situations. During these missions, players have the opportunity to practice addressing these situations with their psychologist, who plays with them. Players have the opportunity to learn more about how to address these situations and gain skill points along
